title: Stenotrophomonas sp. LXM-2 genome sequencing and assembly
description: Stenotrophomonas sp. LXM-2 is an efficient acesulfame-degrading bacterial strain isolated from the activated sludge of a wastewater treatment plant. This strain is capable of utilizing acesulfame, a widely used artificial sweetener and an emerging environmental pollutant, as its sole carbon source for growth under aerobic conditions. Genome sequencing of this strain aims to reveal the genetic basis, specific hydrolytic enzymes, and metabolic pathways involved in acesulfame biodegradation. The genomic data will enrich existing biological resources and provide theoretical support for the bioremediation of sweetener-contaminated wastewater.
